name: Macadamia Spray
label: 150 ml

product-form.quote: Спрей з олією австралійського горіха макадамія

health-feature.quote: Призначений для догляду за сухою шкірою та ламкою і тьмяною шерстю

texts.about_this_item: Spray with Australian macadamia nut oil for dogs and cats. Designed to care for dry skin and brittle, dull coats. Ideal for long-haired, short-haired and wire-haired breeds. Improves the condition of the coat, makes it shiny and eases combing. Especially recommended for show dogs. For external use only.
texts.ingredient_information: Water, macadamia nut oil, hydrogenated ethoxylated castor oil, 3-behenoyloxy-2-hydroxy trimethylammonium chloride, 1,2-propanediol, perfume, 5-bromo-5-nitro-1,3-dioxane.
texts.feeding_instructions: Shake before use. Spray the whole coat from a distance of 30 cm, wait 10 minutes, then comb the coat thoroughly. Take care around the head so the spray does not get into the eyes, mouth, nose or ears. Amount depends on the size of the animal and the length of its coat.
